Metadata.title: GoMechanic
Metadata.description: Car and bike service and repairs at Mukai Chowk, Kiwale, Pune. AC, brakes, tyres, batteries and more, priced before work starts. Book on WhatsApp or call.

story.title: How a visit works
story.lead: Four steps, from your first message to collecting your vehicle.

book.title: Book on WhatsApp or call

visit.title: Bring it to Mukai Chowk
visit.text: Drive or ride to our garage in Kiwale during opening hours.

check.title: We check it and tell you the price
check.text: A mechanic looks at your vehicle and tells you what it needs and what it costs, before any work starts.

collect.title: Collect it and pay at the garage
collect.text: We let you know when it's ready. You pay at the garage when you collect it.

Login.heading: Log in
Login.intro: Log in with your mobile number. We'll send you a 6-digit code by SMS.
Login.consentLabel: I agree that {brand} can use my mobile number to log me in and to contact me by SMS, WhatsApp or phone about my bookings.
Login.notice: We keep your mobile number and when you agreed. We use it only to log you in and to tell you about your bookings. To stop this or delete your data, call the garage.
Login.alreadySentTo: We already sent a code to {number}. It works for 5 minutes.
Login.resendReady: You can ask for a new code now.
Login.help: Trouble logging in? Call us on {phone}.
Login.noScript: Logging in needs JavaScript. You can still call us on {phone} to book.

errors.tooSoon: Please wait a few seconds before asking for another code.
errors.rateLimited: Too many codes for this number. Try again after {time}, or call us.
errors.invalidCode: Enter the 6 digits from the SMS.
errors.wrongCode: That code isn't right, or it has expired. Check the latest SMS, or ask for a new code.
errors.tooManyTries: Too many wrong tries. Ask for a new code.
errors.startOver: This login has expired. Enter your number again.
errors.connection: We couldn't reach the garage's server. Check your connection and try again.

Sms.loginCode: {code} is your {brand} login code. It works for {minutes} minutes. Don't share it with anyone.
